name: Can I repair a bathtub drain myself, or should I call a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a bathtub drain myself, or should I call a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor clogs can sometimes be addressed with plungers or over-the-counter drain cleaners, persistent issues or more complex problems like leaks, broken parts, or deep blockages are best handled by a professional plumber. DIY attempts with harsh chemicals can sometimes damage pipes, and improper repairs can lead to larger, more costly problems down the line. A professional has the tools and expertise to diagnose and resolve issues safely and effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor clogs may be DIY, but persistent issues, leaks, or broken parts are best handled by a professional plumber.
